name: object_forge_flow
description: Prompt to a textured 3D object in two card stages: concept (image-gen z-image — one subject render), lift (img-to-mesh trellis2-native — textured mesh at the high recipe's stamps (1536 detail, the same as every card birth)). WHAT it produces: the lift's textured tri mesh from one prompt line. HOW it runs: both stages are card=, so the {flow:} door submits ONE merged run (image-upscale's 2026-10-04 shape); agents can also drive the cards one at a time through the queue door. Craft surfaces: {model:} door, the bench, or the object_forge POST tool. (The remesh stage left the row 2026-10-13; quad topology is downstream work.)

prompt.description: Required. The object — one clear subject, plain background reads best (a single prop on white beats a busy scene).

image_model.description: Concept generator family: z-image (default) or krea-2.
